बॉक्स ऑफिस पर Ramayana का तूफानी जादू थमने का नाम ही नहीं ले रहा है! 🔥

North America (USA और Canada) में इस फिल्म ने 9वें दिन ही बड़ा धमाका कर दिया है। 💥 Second Friday को 68.67% का तगड़ा जंप लेते हुए फिल्म ने $1.4 million कमाए, जिससे इसका कुल कलेक्शन $19.74 million (लगभग 186.04 करोड़ रुपये) पहुंच गया है।

इसी के साथ Ramayana ने Prabhas की Kalki 2898 AD ($18.57 million) को पछाड़कर North America में चौथे स्थान पर अपना कब्जा जमा लिया है! 🚀

Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी और Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash स्टारर इस फिल्म की नजरें अब Dhurandhar ($20.69 million), Baahubali 2 ($22 million) और Dhurandhar 2 ($28.64 million) के रिकॉर्ड्स तोड़ने पर टिकी हैं। 🎬

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana कमाई के मामले में Dhurandhar 2 का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana North America Box Office: Beats Kalki 2898 AD In 9 Days, Becomes 4th Highest-Grossing Indian Film
ctx.summary:
After a dip on the second Thursday, Ramayana picked up well on Friday (day 9), going past the $1 million mark in North America. 
 The post  Ramayana North America Box Office: Beats Kalki 2898 AD In 9 Days, Becomes 4th Highest-Grossing Indian Film  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
After Dhurandhar 2, Ramayana is turning out to be a historic Indian grosser at the North American box office (USA and Canada). In its opening week, the film had a complete blast, and now the second weekend has started on a high note. On the second Friday, day 9, collections increased, and the total crossed the $19 million mark. In the meantime, it has emerged as the fourth-highest-grossing film of all time in the territory. Keep reading for a detailed report!
The Bollywood magnum opus scored $1.4 million on its second Friday, showing a jump of 68.67% from Thursday’s $830K . Overall, it has grossed a solid $19.74 million at the North American box office. It equals 186.04 crore in Indian rupees. From here, the $30 million milestone looks easily achievable, and it’ll be interesting to see how far it goes after that.
With $19.74 million, Ramayana has surpassed Prabhas’ Kalki 2898 AD ( $18.57 million ) on its 9th day. With this, it has become the fourth-highest-grossing Indian film in North America. With day 10’s numbers, it’ll overtake Dhurandhar ( $20.69 million ) to claim the third spot, and there’s a chance that it might cross Baahubali 2 ( $22 million ) as well to grab the second spot. In the coming days, it’ll dethrone Dhurandhar 2 ( $28.64 million ) to grab the first spot as well.

Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash under the banner of Prime Focus Studios, Monster Mind Creations, and DNEG. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Indira Krishnan, Rakul Preet Singh, Sonal Jha, Vivek Oberoi, and others. The music is composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.
